profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, trading under the ticker TDC. On its own site the company describes itself as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment, and presents its Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform as a way to make AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale. It says its product and service portfolio covers AI, analytics, and cloud solutions, and that it partners with leading providers to supply technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge.

The company's litigation record lists 281 cases in California. No specific products or MCP servers are recorded for it, and no individual lawsuits are listed.
